question.text: The minimum lot size value for Commodity Index Futures on the launch date must be at least:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.41, the minimum lot size must be such that its value shall be at least Rs 5 lakhs on the Index Futures launch date and on every rebalancing date thereafter. The Trap: Rs 1 lakh, Rs 2 lakhs, and Rs 10 lakhs are not the specified minimum; Rs 5 lakhs is the SEBI requirement. Note: The Rs 5 lakh minimum lot value applies on both the launch date and every rebalancing date thereafter.
